_help: Copy this file to config.json (same folder) and edit it. Saved changes apply within a few seconds; no restart needed.

clipOn._multikillMinimum: 2 = double kill and up, 3 = triple and up, 4 = quadra and up, 0 = never clip multikills

audio._help: source = the OBS audio input's name, on = true/false, volume = 0.0 to 1.0. Pushed to OBS when this file is saved and whenever the clipper connects. Delete an entry to leave that input alone.

timing._help: Seconds. After a multikill below a penta the save waits longer in case it grows into a bigger one.

obs._help: The websocket password is read from OBS's own settings file unless passwordFile points at a text file holding it. Never put the password in this file.

sync._help: Two-PC setups: pause Syncthing while a game runs so uploads never compete with League. syncthingConfig is Syncthing's config.xml (empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%\Syncthing\config.xml).

cleanup._help: rawClipDays: raw clips in clipsDir go to the Recycle Bin after this many days (0 = never). If shortsDir is set, clips with no short there yet get twice as long. Move a clip out of clipsDir to keep it.
